newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's KFA buys 25,000T of Brazilian soymeal.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's KFA buys 25,000T of Brazilian soymeal.

text.p: The Korea Feed Association (KFA) on Friday bought 25,000 tonnes of Brazilian soymeal at $337.50 a tonne C&F, traders said.
They said the association bought the soymeal from Continental Grain through a closed tender.
Shipment was set for May 5-25 and arrival was slated to the South Korean ports of Kunsan and Ulsan.
They said premium for the port rotation was set at $1.50 a tonne.

Meanwhile, South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation (NLCF) bought 2,500 tonnes of Indian rapeseed meal at $144 a tonne C&F from Peter Cremer. Shipment was set for April to the western port of Inchon.
